purpose: Verified contract for citizen-facing clarification dialogue.
core_principle: MINIMUM NECESSARY QUESTION, CLEAR REASON, NO LOSS OF PRIOR CONTEXT.
clarification_rule: Ask only the unresolved information that materially blocks the next investigation stage.
plain_language_rule: Explain why the requested information matters without exposing internal reasoning or technical workflow details.
known_unknown_rule: Keep verified facts, citizen assertions and unresolved items visibly distinct.
choice_rule: Use bounded choices when they reduce ambiguity without constraining the citizen beyond what is necessary.
no_question_rule: If the investigation can proceed safely with the information already available, do not ask an unnecessary clarification.
privacy_rule: Clarification questions should not request unnecessary personal information.
verification_boundary: Dialogue communicates investigation state; it does not establish property facts or legal conclusions.
